annotations.title: Trucking fleet KPI scorecard and operating ratio

description: Score a period of fleet operations: operating ratio, revenue and cost per mile, empty miles, fuel economy, utilization and on-time delivery. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.
